repos.description: A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader
repos.summary_zh: yt-dlp 是一款功能强大的开源命令行视频音频下载工具，支持数千个网站。它提供丰富的格式选择、元数据修改、字幕下载及强大的后处理能力，是跨平台媒体抓取与自动归档的终极利器。
repos.summary_en: yt-dlp is a highly feature-rich command-line audio and video downloader supporting thousands of global websites. It offers powerful format selection, extensive post-processing options like metadata modification and subtitle downloading, and robust cross-platform capabilities, making it the ultimate tool for automated media retrieval and archiving.

repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Tauri 和 Rust 构建的跨平台 Clash Meta 图形化客户端，支持多系统运行。内置 mihomo 内核，提供可视化节点与规则编辑、配置文件增强、TUN 模式及 WebDAV 同步，为用户提供高效、个性化的代理体验。
repos.summary_en: A modern, cross-platform GUI client for Clash Meta, built on Tauri 2 and Rust. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, offering visual configuration, powerful rule editing, TUN mode, and WebDAV sync for a highly tailored proxy experience.

repos.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others
repos.summary_zh: v2rayN是一款跨平台图形界面客户端，支持Windows、Linux和macOS。集成Xray、sing-box等多种代理核心，提供多架构支持与GPG签名校验，保障安全与完整性，是桌面端高效的网络代理工具。
repos.summary_en: v2rayN is a cross-platform GUI client supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It integrates Xray, sing-box, and other proxy cores, offering multi-architecture support and GPG-signed releases for secure, reliable, and user-friendly desktop network proxy management.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Reach 是面向 AI Agent 的开源 CLI 工具，一键赋予全网阅读与搜索能力。它零 API 费用，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，有效解决网页访问限制、平台封锁与付费 API 痛点。基于 Python，跨平台部署，显著降低 AI 与互联网交互门槛。
repos.summary_en: Agent Reach is an open-source CLI tool for AI agents, enabling one-click internet reading and searching. With zero API fees, it supports Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu, addressing web access limits, platform blocks, and paid API issues. Python-based and cross-platform, it significantly lowers the barrier for AI-web interaction.

repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors
repos.summary_zh: OmniRoute是一个免费MIT许可的AI网关，通过统一端点聚合359个提供商、1200+模型，支持Claude Code、Cursor等主流编码工具。其智能配额感知自动回退与RTK+Caveman压缩技术可节省高达95%的令牌成本，适用于需要低成本、多模型访问的开发者与团队。
repos.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free MIT-licensed AI gateway that aggregates 359 providers and over 1,200 models behind a unified endpoint, compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and other coding tools. It features quota-aware auto-fallback and RTK+Caveman compression to save up to 95% tokens, making it ideal for developers and teams seeking low-cost, multi-model AI access.

repos.description: Multi functional app to find duplicates, empty folders, similar images etc.
repos.summary_zh: Czkawka/Krokiet 是一款基于 Rust 的多功能跨平台桌面应用，专注于快速查找并清理系统中的重复文件、空文件夹、相似图片及临时文件等。它拥有高效的多线程算法和友好的 GUI/CLI 界面，支持多平台运行且无广告、无联网，是强大的系统清理与维护工具。
repos.summary_en: Czkawka is a fast, memory-safe Rust utility for finding and removing clutter like duplicate files, empty folders, similar images, and temporary files. Offering multiplatform support, efficient multithreading, cache scanning, and both GUI and CLI frontends, it provides a private, ad-free system cleaning solution.

repos.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署
repos.summary_zh: IPTV-API是一款功能全面的IPTV直播源自动化采集与管理工具，支持多源聚合、智能校验测速及自定义频道，输出M3U、TXT及API，支持CLI、GUI和Docker多端部署。
repos.summary_en: IPTV-API is a comprehensive automated tool for IPTV live stream collection, validation, and speed testing. It aggregates sources, filters high-quality channels, and outputs customized playlists in M3U, TXT, or API formats. With support for IPv4/IPv6, Docker, CLI, and GUI, it provides a robust solution for seamless live TV playback.

repos.description: 一个基于 React native 开发的音乐软件
repos.summary_zh: LX Music移动版是基于React Native与Redux的开源音乐播放器，支持Android，允许自定义音频源并具备数据同步功能。采用Apache 2.0协议，适合追求个性化的音乐爱好者。
repos.summary_en: LX Music Mobile is an open-source music player application developed with React Native and Redux, offering a highly customizable experience for Android users. The app supports custom audio sources, enabling users to pull streaming links from various providers, and includes an optional data synchronization service for multi-device compatibility. Licensed under Apache 2.0, it is designed for music enthusiasts who prioritize flexibility and personalization over out-of-the-box simplicity. The project maintains active development on the dev branch, with regular releases and community contributions welcome.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的多协议代理管理平台，支持 VLESS、Trojan 协议及图形化 KV 配置。集成家宽链式路由、自动延迟测试与多客户端订阅转换，实现一键唤醒与高效运维。
repos.summary_en: A multi-protocol proxy management platform on Cloudflare Workers, supporting VLESS/Trojan with graphical KV configuration. It integrates residential broadband routing, latency testing, and multi-client subscription conversion for efficient ops.

repos.description: Open source free capture HTTP(S) traffic  software ProxyPin, supporting full platform systems
repos.summary_zh: ProxyPin是一款基于Flutter的跨平台开源HTTP(S)抓包工具，支持全平台系统。它集扫码连接、域名过滤、JS脚本、请求重写与解密功能于一体，界面美观，是开发者抓取、调试和修改网络流量的得力助手。
repos.summary_en: ProxyPin is an open-source, free, and cross-platform HTTP(S) traffic capture and debugging tool built with Flutter, supporting Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, and Linux. It offers features like mobile scan-to-connect, domain filtering, JavaScript scripting, request rewriting, and AES decryption. With a beautiful UI, it helps developers easily intercept, inspect, rewrite, and map network requests for efficient app debugging.

repos.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, clean IP,  Fragment, Warp, Warp pro and routing settings for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores.
repos.summary_zh: 该面板提供VLESS、Trojan和Warp配置的Worker订阅，内置私有DoH服务器及链式代理，支持全DNS、清洁IP、Fragment、Warp Pro和路由设置，适用于Amnezia、Wireguard、Sing-box、Clash/Mihomo和Xray核心的跨平台客户端，确保网络自由与安全。
repos.summary_en: BPB Worker Panel is a GUI panel that provides subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan, and Warp configurations, along with a private DoH server and chain proxies. It offers comprehensive settings for DNS, clean IP, Fragment, Warp Pro, and routing, ensuring connectivity even when domains or services are blocked. Designed for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo, and Xray cores, it supports bypassing censorship and sanctions, providing a secure and private proxy solution for users worldwide. With intuitive navigation and full customizability, it is an ideal tool for managing network privacy.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费无广告的追剧资源指南，通过人工精选和每日自动化检测确保资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等多类资源，社区共同维护，适合追剧爱好者快速获取可靠资源。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free guide for drama chasing resources, featuring manually curated selections and daily automated availability checks. It aggregates online videos, apps, cloud storage searches, magnets, subtitles, TVBox configs, IPTV sources, and more, community-maintained for reliable resource discovery.

repos.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.
repos.summary_zh: MyIP是一个开源、支持Docker一键自部署的全能IP工具箱，集成多源IP查询、WebRTC与DNS泄露检测、浏览器指纹分析、全球网速与延迟测试、MTR路由追踪及Whois查询。结合PWA技术支持，旨在为用户提供一站式网络隐私保护、连接质量诊断与基础设施深度探测解决方案。
repos.summary_en: MyIP is an open-source, all-in-one IP toolbox designed for comprehensive network diagnostics and privacy protection. Self-hostable via a single Docker command and supported as a PWA, it integrates multi-source IP lookup, WebRTC & DNS leak detection, browser fingerprinting, global speed and latency tests, MTR, and Whois queries. It provides users with an all-in-one solution for security assessment and infrastructure exploration.

repos.description: OK影视、tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。
repos.summary_zh: qist/tvbox仓库提供多种TVBox配置文件，如OK影视、猫影视等多源配置，适用于电视盒子应用实现直播与点播观看。技术亮点包括JSON配置管理、JavaScript脚本集成及代理优化，支持跨平台使用。核心价值在于简化影视源配置，提升个性化观看体验，但需注意免责声明，仅限学习研究用途。
repos.summary_en: The qist/tvbox repository offers various TVBox configuration files, including multi-source options for OK影视 and Cat影视, suitable for TV box apps to stream live and on-demand content. Key technical features encompass JSON configuration management, JavaScript script integration, and proxy optimization for cross-platform use. The core value lies in simplifying video source configuration to enhance personalized viewing, while users must adhere to the disclaimer for legal and educational purposes only.

repos.description: Cross-platform internet upload/download manager for HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, magnet-link, BitTorrent, m3u8, ed2k, and online videos.  WebDAV client, FTP client, SSH client.
repos.summary_zh: FileCentipede是一款跨平台多协议下载管理器，支持HTTP、FTP、SSH、BT及WebDAV，并集成浏览器插件，可智能提取网页音视频，实现一站式高效上传、下载与文件管理。
repos.summary_en: FileCentipede is a powerful, cross-platform, multi-protocol download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, SSH, WebDAV, and BitTorrent. With browser integration, it intelligently extracts online audio and video, providing a one-stop solution for high-speed uploads, downloads, and comprehensive file management.

repos.description: 致力于成为中文区命中率最高的广告过滤列表，实现精确的广告屏蔽和隐私保护。anti-AD 现已支持 AdGuardHome，dnsmasq，Surge，Pi-Hole，Clash, mihomo，smartdns，sing-box 等网络组件。完全兼容常见的广告过滤工具所支持的各种广告过滤列表格式
repos.summary_zh: anti-AD 是专注于中文区的高命中率广告过滤与隐私保护列表，通过合并、优化主流 hosts 及 adblock 规则并剔除失效域名，实现 DNS 层面的精准屏蔽。全面兼容 AdGuardHome、Clash、Surge、sing-box 等主流网络组件，有效拦截电视盒子、App 内置广告及隐私追踪站点，守护个人隐私。
repos.summary_en: anti-AD is a high-hit-rate ad filtering and privacy protection list tailored for the Chinese region. By merging and optimizing mainstream hosts and adblock rules while removing dead domains, it achieves precise blocking at the DNS layer. Fully compatible with AdGuardHome, Clash, Surge, and sing-box, it effectively blocks TV box ads, in-app ads, and privacy trackers.

repos.description: 一个支持windows/linux/mac的文本编辑器，目标是做中国人自己的编辑器，来自中国。
repos.summary_zh: Notepad-- 是一款轻量级跨平台文本编辑器，致力于国产软件替代，支持Windows、Linux和Mac系统。重点优化国产信创Uos系统，具有跨平台兼容性和高效编辑能力，适用于日常办公和开发场景，提供稳定可靠的文本编辑体验。
repos.summary_en: Notepad-- is a lightweight cross-platform text editor focused on providing a domestic alternative for Chinese users. It supports Windows, Linux, and Mac operating systems, with special optimization for domestic innovation systems like UOS. The key features include cross-platform compatibility, lightweight design, and efficient text editing capabilities, making it suitable for various office and development tasks.

repos.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.
repos.summary_zh: MediaGo是一款跨平台视频下载工具，内置流量嗅探技术，可自动识别并抓取m3u8/HLS流，支持Bilibili、YouTube等千余站点。提供桌面应用、Docker部署及浏览器扩展，集成AI助手技能，通过HTTP API实现自动化下载与格式转换，无需复杂配置，一键获取高清视频。
repos.summary_en: MediaGo is a cross-platform video downloader with built-in sniffing to automatically detect and grab m3u8/HLS streams, supporting Bilibili, YouTube, and over a thousand sites. It offers desktop app, Docker deployment, and browser extension, with AI assistant integration and HTTP API for automated downloading and format conversion, no complex setup required.

repos.description: 去广告合并规则，每8个小时更新一次。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目定时自动合并、去重并清洗多源广告过滤规则，通过DNS解析剔除失效域名，生成适用于AdGuard、dnsmasq等平台的轻量/完整版拦截列表，提升广告拦截效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: This project automatically merges and cleans multi-source ad-blocking rules on a regular basis, filtering out dead domains via DNS resolution. It generates optimized blocklists for platforms like AdGuard and dnsmasq, ensuring efficient and accurate ad-blocking.

repos.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本是一款功能全面的 VPS 服务器测评工具，支持主流 Linux 发行版及多种架构，通过交互式菜单或参数化命令实现网络质量检测、路由追踪和 IP 评估，适用于 VPS 选型与网络诊断，显著提升运维效率。
repos.summary_en: This script is a comprehensive VPS server benchmarking tool, supporting major Linux distributions and multiple architectures. It provides interactive and non-interactive modes for network quality testing, route tracing, and IP evaluation, ideal for VPS selection and network diagnostics, enhancing operational efficiency.

repos.description: A cross-platform Electron Desktop App to stream and download any Movie, TV Series or Anime in the World. Zero Ads and Tracking
repos.summary_zh: Streambert是跨平台无广告影视播放下载工具，基于Electron技术，支持电影、动漫与电视剧的高清流媒体播放、多线程高速下载、字幕管理及个性化库追踪，打造安全极速的私人影音体验。
repos.summary_en: Streambert is a powerful, cross-platform desktop application built with Electron, designed to provide a completely ad-free and tracker-free media experience. It allows users to seamlessly stream and download movies, TV series, and anime in high definition, leveraging fast, multithreaded downloading technology. Featuring intuitive subtitle download tools, a highly customizable interface, and a comprehensive personal library for tracking watched content, it also offers daily trending discovery. Streambert ensures a fast, private, and highly customizable offline entertainment solution for every global media lover.

repos.description: 小白自建代理神器！ArgoSBX一键无交互小钢炮脚本💣：Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核自动搭配；支持VPS、Docker、容器多环境部署；套CDN的5大方案+套WARP的15种组合；已支持协议：Naiveproxy、AnyTLS、Any-reality、Vless-xhttp-reality-vision-enc、Vless-tcp-reality-vision、Vless-xhttp-vision-enc、Vless-ws-vision-enc、Shadowsocks-2022、Hysteria2、Tuic、Socks5、Vmess-ws、Argo临时/固定隧道
repos.summary_zh: Argosbx是一键无交互代理搭建脚本，集成Sing-box、Xray与Argo三内核，支持VPS与Docker多环境部署。内置15种WARP出站组合与5大CDN方案，无需域名即可快速搭建高性能多协议科学上网节点。
repos.summary_en: Argosbx is a lightweight, one-click script integrating Sing-box, Xray, and Cloudflare Argo for proxy deployment. Supporting VPS and Docker, it simplifies setup with zero interaction, offering 15 WARP combinations, 5 CDN schemes, and robust multi-protocol support without requiring a domain.

repos.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。边录边传0落盘
repos.summary_zh: biliup 是一款自动化直播录制与投稿工具，支持B站、抖音、Twitch、YouTube等19个平台，具备边录边传、实时预览、弹幕抓取、多机录制及AI自动切片等特性，可实现24小时无人值守运行，适用于个人主播与内容搬运。
repos.summary_en: biliup is an automated live stream recording and submission tool supporting 19 platforms including Bilibili, Douyin, Twitch, and YouTube. It features zero-disk-buffer upload, real-time preview, danmaku capture, multi-camera recording, and AI-powered highlight clipping, enabling 24/7 unattended operation for streamers and content curators.

repos.description: 一个基于 Go 语言的全网音乐搜索与下载工具。支持 CLI 命令行与 Web 服务双模式，内置网易云、QQ、酷狗、Bilibili、汽水音乐等 10+ 个主流平台，支持多源并发搜索与无损音质解析。music-dl交流群：755087923
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Go 语言的多平台音乐搜索与无损下载工具，支持 Web、TUI 终端及桌面应用多模式运行。聚合网易云、QQ、酷狗等 10+ 主流平台，支持并发搜索、歌单解析与批量无损下载，提供本地歌单管理与扫码登录体验。
repos.summary_en: This is a powerful Go-based music search and lossless download tool supporting Web, TUI terminal, and desktop application modes. It aggregates over ten mainstream music platforms, offering concurrent search, playlist and album parsing, and high-quality batch downloads. Features include local playlist management, cookie-based login, and extensive lossless audio format support for superior playback quality.

repos.description: 本项目已停止维护。
repos.summary_zh: BiliTools是针对哔哩哔哩平台的自动化辅助工具，专注于视频解析与数据处理。因收到平台委托律所的法律函件，指控构成侵权及不正当竞争，项目已于2026年7月正式停止维护与所有版本发布。
repos.summary_en: BiliTools serves as an automated utility tailored for the Bilibili platform, focusing on video parsing and data processing. Following a legal letter from a commissioned law firm accusing it of infringement and unfair competition, the project officially ceased maintenance, updates, and all version releases in July 2026, marking a significant loss for the community.

repos.description: x-ui精简修改版脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp传输协议、ENC加密、MLDSA65加密，集成argo固定临时双隧道（可共存）、Psiphon赛风VPN（30个国家）分流功能，支持部分节点聚合订阅、sing-box订阅、clash-meta订阅的配置输出
repos.summary_zh: x-ui-yg 是一款精简修改版脚本，专注于简化代理服务器搭建。它支持 Hysteria2、Xhttp 等先进协议和多种加密方式，集成 Argo 隧道和 Psiphon VPN 分流，可生成多种订阅配置。适用于个人或企业快速部署高性能代理服务，技术亮点在于本地化节点生成和多平台支持。
repos.summary_en: x-ui-yg is a streamlined modified script for setting up proxy servers. It supports advanced protocols like Hysteria2 and Xhttp, with various encryption methods. Integrated with Argo tunnels and Psiphon VPN for traffic splitting, it outputs multiple subscription formats. Ideal for quickly deploying high-performance proxy services, with key features including local node generation and multi-platform support.

repos.description: Video Duplicate Finder - Crossplatform
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台视频去重工具，精准识别分辨率、水印、裁剪等变换后的相似视频。集成本地AI大模型与音频指纹技术，提供多端界面，适用于本地和NAS媒体库的高效去重与片段检测。
repos.summary_en: A powerful cross-platform tool to find duplicate videos and images, even with different resolutions, watermarks, or heavy edits. It integrates local AI vision models and audio fingerprinting, offering GUI, CLI, and Web interfaces for efficient media library deduplication and partial clip detection.

repos.description: MoonTVPlus 是基于 MoonTV v100 二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器。它在原版基础上新增了外部播放器支持、视频超分、弹幕系统、评论抓取等实用功能，提供更强大的观影体验。
repos.summary_zh: MoonTVPlus是基于MoonTV的增强版影视聚合播放器，无缝集成外部播放器、WebGPU视频超分、弹幕系统及AI智能问片，支持PWA与多端同步，为用户打造极致的私人定制观影体验。
repos.summary_en: MoonTVPlus is an enhanced video aggregation player featuring external player support, WebGPU super-resolution, danmaku, and AI search, delivering a seamless cross-platform viewing experience.

repos.description: The third-party Telegram android app.
repos.summary_zh: Nagram是一款基于NekoX的第三方Android Telegram客户端，内置多协议代理与丰富增强功能。它支持多账号无限登录、自定义文本样式、消息合并及语音降噪，致力于提供安全、个性化且功能全面的即时通讯体验。
repos.summary_en: Nagram is a third-party Android Telegram client built on NekoX, featuring robust built-in proxy support (VMess, SSR, Trojan, etc.) and extensive customization. It offers unlimited accounts, message combining, forced copy, voice enhancement, and advanced privacy controls, delivering a highly secure and feature-rich messaging experience.

repos.description: Save Any Telegram File to Anywhere 📂 (Alist, Disk, Webdav, S3, Rclone...) . Support restrict saving content and files beyond telegram.
repos.summary_zh: SaveAny Bot 是一款强大的 Telegram 文件自动化归档与下载工具。支持将各类媒体及受限内容批量、流式传输至本地、Alist、S3、WebDAV 等多元存储后端。集成 yt-dlp 与 Aria2，实现跨平台媒体高效自动化采集与智能分类管理。
repos.summary_en: SaveAny Bot is a powerful Telegram automation tool designed to seamlessly save files, media, and restricted content to diverse storage backends like Alist, S3, WebDAV, and local disks. It features batch downloading, streaming transfers, and chat monitoring. With integrated yt-dlp and Aria2 support, it enables automated collection and organization of media from Telegram and over 1,000 websites.

repos.description: 哔哩哔哩 bilibili B站 视频 下载器，图形界面 + nfo刮削 + 广告标记 + 字幕下载 + 弹幕下载，轻松将视频加入emby等媒体库
repos.summary_zh: 基于Tauri的跨平台B站视频下载工具，集成高清视频、CC字幕、弹幕转ASS及自动化NFO刮削。支持广告智能跳过与章节标记，一键将B站视频高效整理并导入Emby等主流媒体库，实现个性化媒体管理。
repos.summary_en: Cross-platform Bilibili video downloader featuring a modern GUI, high-quality downloads, and comprehensive media management. It supports CC subtitles, danmaku-to-ASS conversion, automated NFO scraping, and smart ad-marking. Easily download videos, courses, and bangumi, organizing them seamlessly into Emby and Jellyfin media libraries.

repos.description: Open-Box 一体化透明代理：OpenWrt / Debian / Ubuntu / Docker；自有程序闭源，第三方组件遵守原许可。
repos.summary_zh: Open-Box 是一体化透明代理，支持 OpenWrt/Debian/Ubuntu/Docker 路由器端及多平台客户端。图形化面板无需配置文件即可管理订阅、分流与防火墙，集成 sing-box 内核与完整 Geo 数据，实现规则调试、链式代理与 DNS 直连，适用于局域网科学上网与流量优化。
repos.summary_en: Open-Box is an all-in-one transparent proxy solution with router support for OpenWrt, Debian, Ubuntu, Docker, and clients for Android, macOS, Windows, Linux. Its graphical panel enables management of subscriptions, traffic splitting, and firewalls without configuration files, integrating the sing-box kernel and full Geo data, featuring rule debugging, chain proxy, and direct DNS, suitable for scientific browsing and traffic optimization on LAN devices.

repos.description: TaoSync是一个适用于OpenList v3+的自动化同步工具/Sync for OpenList/AList
repos.summary_zh: TaoSync 是一款专为 OpenList/AList v3+ 设计的自动化同步工具，内置存储引擎。支持跨平台部署、定时任务与多端同步备份，适用于本地与云盘间的文件自动同步、备份及定时下载，提升数据管理效率。
repos.summary_en: TaoSync is an automated synchronization tool for OpenList/AList v3+ featuring a built-in storage engine. It supports cross-platform deployment, scheduled cron jobs, and versatile sync modes, ideal for multi-cloud backups, local-to-cloud syncing, and off-peak scheduled downloads.

repos.description: 🔥🔥🔥一行命令，轻松搞定SSL证书自动续期。 SSL泛域名证书，SSL证书管理，SSL证书自动续期，SSL证书自动更新，七牛云、阿里云、腾讯云、CDN、OSS、https证书管理,https证书管理,免费SSL证书,TLS证书自动续签,nginx证书自动续期工具，nginx证书管理。从此告别Let's Encrypt
repos.summary_zh: httpsok 是一款高效的 SSL 证书自动续期工具，专为 Nginx、Apache 等服务器设计。通过一行命令实现证书自动检测、续签和更新，支持泛域名、多服务器及主流云服务如 CDN、OSS。兼容性强，提供监控提醒，简化运维流程，确保网站安全。
repos.summary_en: httpsok is an efficient SSL certificate auto-renewal tool designed for Nginx, Apache, etc. It enables one-command auto-detection, renewal, and update of certificates for wildcard domains and multiple servers, compatible with cloud services like CDN and OSS. Offers strong compatibility and monitoring alerts, simplifying operations and ensuring security.

repos.description: AI Coding 福利站导航：免费白嫖 Claude Code / Codex 的中转站与公益站合集，含额度、模型、价格自动更新与一键配置脚本
repos.summary_zh: 聚合多个 AI 编码中转站与公益站，提供免费额度与一键配置脚本，助力开发者零成本体验 Claude Code、Codex 等顶级模型。实时监控站点可用性，自动更新额度与价格，支持多种协议，是 AI 编码探索的高效入口。
repos.summary_en: Aggregate multiple AI coding relay and charity stations, offering free credits and one-click setup scripts, enabling developers to access top models like Claude Code and Codex at zero cost. With real-time availability monitoring and auto-updating data, it supports multiple protocols, serving as an efficient entry point for AI coding exploration.

repos.description: LX Music 数据同步服务端，同时支持了部分lx-music-desktop的网页端实现。
repos.summary_zh: LX Music增强型数据同步服务端，集成全能Web播放器，支持多源聚合搜索、本地音乐库深度管理、多平台歌单同步及个性化主题定制，提供无缝的跨端音乐同步与网页播放体验。
repos.summary_en: LX Music sync server with built-in web player, multi-source search, local library management, and cross-platform synchronization.

repos.description: 基于lx-netease-music-mobile改版，满足个人需求，仅个人自用！！！
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个基于 React Native 的跨平台音乐播放器，聚合网易云、QQ、酷狗等多平台音乐资源，支持自定义音源插件、主题美化、本地音乐管理及 WebDAV 同步，具备小爱音箱推送等智能联动功能，适用于个人多平台音乐播放与管理。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a cross-platform music player based on React Native, aggregating music from multiple platforms like NetEase, QQ, and Kugou. It supports custom audio source plugins, theme customization, local music management, WebDAV sync, and Xiao Ai speaker integration for smart home use, ideal for personal multi-platform music playback and management.

repos.description: 基于 React + Capacitor 的免费音乐 App，支持多音源搜索、网易云登录、主流平台歌单导入，以及 B 站音源搜索播放，安装包仅 2.5 MB。基于 GD Studio's Online Music Platform API。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 React 与 Capacitor 的超轻量多源聚合音乐播放器，支持多音源搜索、主流歌单导入及 B 站播放。安装包仅 2.5 MB，兼具 PWA 与原生移动端体验，并提供智能音源回退与数据同步。
repos.summary_en: Otter Music is a lightweight, multi-source aggregated music player built with React and Capacitor. Supporting extensive platform searches, playlist imports, and Bilibili playback within a tiny 2.5 MB package, it delivers near-native mobile and PWA experiences, featuring smart audio source fallback and seamless data synchronization.

repos.description: Independent, unofficial Telegram client for Android, Windows, and macOS. Sign in with your existing Telegram account — built with Flutter on TDLib.
repos.summary_zh: Navo是一款基于Flutter和TDLib构建的跨平台非官方Telegram客户端，支持Android、iOS、Windows和macOS多端登录。其核心价值在于通过跨平台技术提供独立、高效且安全的即时通讯服务，实现无缝的跨设备聊天体验。
repos.summary_en: Navo is a highly independent, unofficial Telegram client engineered to deliver a seamless, native messaging experience across Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS. Built using the Flutter framework integrated with the powerful TDLib library, it allows users to log in with their existing Telegram accounts safely. Its core strength lies in cross-platform consistency, ensuring efficient message synchronization and a robust, independent chat interface on every major desktop and mobile operating system.

repos.description: 一款高性能、现代化支持的全栈多源影视采集聚合系统，用于搭建自己的私人影视库，支持Tvbox与Ecohub原生应用
repos.summary_zh: EcoHub是一款高性能全栈多源影视聚合系统，用于快速搭建私人影视库。它集成自动化采集与后台管理，支持TVBox与鸿蒙原生应用，基于Go与Next.js，提供高性能自托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: EcoHub is a high-performance, modern full-stack multi-source video aggregation and collection system designed to help users quickly build their own private media library. It features powerful automated data collection, an intuitive management backend, and a seamless streaming web interface. Supporting TVBox and native HarmonyOS/Android applications, it is built on Go, Next.js, MySQL, and Redis, offering a highly efficient and secure self-hosted deployment solution for personal media management.

repos.description: C-SSH 0.9.0 · Windows / Apple Silicon Mac / Android · SSH, RDP, AI & self-hosted cloud. Manual download required. 三端正式版，本次须手动下载安装。
repos.summary_zh: C-SSH是一款跨平台服务器运维客户端，集成SSH、RDP、AI对话及自托管云功能。支持Windows、Mac、Android及Linux多端手动下载，本地Agent无需云端登录，数据保留本地，提升运维效率与安全性。
repos.summary_en: C-SSH is a powerful cross-platform server operations client integrating SSH, RDP, AI, and self-hosted cloud capabilities. It supports manual downloads across Windows, macOS, Android, and Linux, featuring local Agent support without requiring cloud login, keeping AI conversations and credentials local for secure, efficient, and flexible server management.

repos.description: 海因影视，用于lunatv（moontv）的Android TV客户端，以及手机、Windows等多平台客户端，本地缓存比网页版更流畅的访问速度
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台 LunaTV 影视客户端，支持 TV、手机、Windows 及 Linux 多端同步。通过本地缓存与多播放器后端，实现超越网页版的流畅播放，完美适配大屏焦点导航与低版本安卓设备。
repos.summary_en: HeinPlay is a high-performance, cross-platform LunaTV client built with Flutter, supporting Android TV, mobile, Windows, Linux, and HarmonyOS. By leveraging local caching and flexible player backends like fvp and ExoPlayer, it provides smoother streaming than the official web version, optimized for TV focus navigation and legacy Android devices.

repos.summary_zh: ring1012/r1-iot-java 仓库提供了一个基于 Java 的物联网解决方案，专门用于控制和集成斐讯 R1 智能音箱。核心价值在于通过 Docker 容器化技术实现快速部署和运维自动化，简化安装与维护流程。应用场景包括智能家居设备管理、远程控制及自动化任务。技术亮点包括跨平台兼容性、灵活的环境变量配置以及数据卷挂载支持，确保高效可靠的运行。
repos.summary_en: The ring1012/r1-iot-java repository offers a Java-based IoT solution for controlling and integrating the Phicomm R1 smart speaker. It utilizes Docker containerization for rapid deployment and operations automation, streamlining setup and maintenance. Applications span smart home device management, remote control, and automated tasks. Key technical highlights include cross-platform compatibility, flexible configuration via environment variables, and volume mounting for efficient operation.

repos.description: go-rename 照片视频重命名工具 支持Windows/MacOS/Linux等各平台
repos.summary_zh: go-rename 是基于 Go 语言的跨平台照片视频重命名工具。通过提取 EXIF 拍摄时间、文件元数据及 MD5 值，实现智能排序、去重与规范化命名，有效解决多设备照片重名与整理难题。
repos.summary_en: go-rename is a powerful, cross-platform photo and video renaming utility built with the Go language. By extracting EXIF shooting times, file metadata, and MD5 hashes, it enables intelligent sorting, deduplication, and standardized naming, effectively resolving file name conflicts during photo organization across multiple devices.

repos.summary_zh: MageKit 是基于 Rust 和 GPUI 的跨平台桌面媒体工具，集成视频下载、网页捕获与直播录制。它深度整合 yt-dlp、FFmpeg，提供高效、原生的多媒体任务管理体验。
repos.summary_en: MageKit is a powerful, native desktop media toolkit designed for cross-platform video downloading, webpage media capture, and live stream recording. Built with Rust and GPUI, it seamlessly integrates core tools like yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and Streamlink to provide a unified, efficient workspace for managing complex media tasks and local tool environments.

repos.summary_zh: luci-app-pushbot 是一款专为 OpenWRT 路由器设计的插件，支持向钉钉、企业微信、飞书、Bark 等多平台推送消息。它主要用于路由器状态监控，包括 IP 变动、设备上下线、CPU 负载和流量统计等，并可通过定时任务自动推送运行状态。插件具备 MAC 白名单、免打扰等高级功能，适用于网络运维和设备管理，帮助用户实时掌握网络动态，提升运维效率。
repos.summary_en: luci-app-pushbot is an OpenWRT router plugin that supports message push to multiple platforms such as DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, and Bark. It is designed for router status monitoring, including IP changes, device online/offline alerts, CPU load, and traffic statistics. The plugin offers features like MAC whitelisting and do-not-disturb modes, suitable for network operations and device management, enabling real-time network monitoring and improving operational efficiency.
